name: Ghibli Museum, Mitaka
intro: A small museum about the art and animation of Studio Ghibli, the studio behind My Neighbor Totoro and Spirited Away. There are no tickets at the door: every visitor needs an advance ticket for a set date and entry time, and a whole month goes on sale at once, so popular days go within minutes.

facts.price: ¥1,000 for adults (19 and over); ¥100 to ¥700 for ages 4 to 18
facts.bookAhead: Up to one month: the next month goes on sale on the 10th

statusNote: Read from the official tickets page.
popularityNote: Keyword data (Oct 2025 to Sep 2026): four searches about 50,000 a month each ("ghibli museum tickets", "studio ghibli museum tickets", "ghibli tickets", "ghibli museum reservation"), more than any other place at that level.
difficultyNote: Travel guides (for example japantravelplanning.com) report popular dates selling out within minutes of the 10:00 release.
bookingSteps: Check the calendar on the official tickets page for days the museum is closed.
Open Lawson Ticket's English page, linked from the official tickets page. Lawson Ticket is the museum's only ticket seller.
Before sale day, register as a free Lawson WEB member. Registration includes verifying a mobile phone number.
Register under the name on your passport. Tickets are issued in the account holder's name.
At 10:00 Japan time on the 10th, choose a date, an entry time and up to six tickets. Have two or three back-up dates ready. Each account can buy once a month.
Choose the e-ticket. From November 2026 visits, it opens in your phone's browser after SMS verification; a screenshot or printout of the QR code is not accepted.
On the day, the buyer enters together with the whole group, within one hour of the entry time. Bring your passport.
visitorTips: After purchase, the date and name can't be changed and tickets aren't refunded.
Staff may check the buyer's ID at the entrance. Resold tickets are refused.
If you miss out, the other official route from overseas is a Sunrise Tours JTB bus tour that includes museum entry.

faq.q: When do Ghibli Museum tickets go on sale?
faq.a: On the 10th of every month at 10:00 Japan time, for visits in the following month.

faq.q: Can I buy Ghibli Museum tickets from overseas?
faq.a: Yes, through Lawson Ticket. Its English page is linked from the museum's official tickets page. You need a free Lawson WEB account with a verified mobile phone number.

faq.q: Are resale Ghibli Museum tickets valid?
faq.a: No. The name on the ticket is checked against ID at the entrance, and transferred tickets are refused.
